description:

description:

description:

description:

title: Killer Cases
description:
S01 E05 — Murder In A Wisconsin Field
Nicole VanderHeyden is found shot to death in a Wisconsin farm field; police immediately arrest her live-in boyfriend, who waited 18 hours to report her missing and has a history of domestic violence.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S01 E02 — Murder Under a Blue Moon
When Richard Smith fails to show up for work, police discover the murdered bodies of Smith, his mother and brother in their home.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S01 E01 — The Doctor Is Dead
Rising social media star Dr. Teresa Sievers is found bludgeoned to death in her kitchen; detectives quickly come to focus on her husband, Mark, who had taken out a large life insurance policy on his successful wife, in a murder-for-hire scheme.

title: Killer Cases
description:
